_README: Nasdaq's public quote API is keyless and, unlike Yahoo, does not rate-limit
this project. It only serves US listings, so anything held on a European
venue has to be mapped to a US line here.
symbol     the Nasdaq ticker to fetch
name       display name shown on the site for this holding
fidelity   'exact' = the same security, so the EUR return is identical
once FX is applied. 'proxy' = a DIFFERENT instrument tracking
the same index; its return is close but not the real one.
note       maintainer's note. Never displayed — it explains the mapping
to whoever reads this file next.
To change how a holding is labelled on the page, edit `name` here, or set
`name:` on the leg in the log entry, which overrides this.

22UA.DE.name: BioNTech
22UA.DE.note: Same BioNTech ADR (US09075V1026), NASDAQ line instead of the Xetra one. Quoted in USD; the EUR return matches once FX is applied. Pays no dividend.

CIBR.L.name: First Trust Cybersecurity UCITS ETF
CIBR.L.note: PROXY. Held line is the First Trust Cybersecurity UCITS ETF (IE00BF16M727) on LSE; this is the US First Trust NASDAQ Cybersecurity ETF. Same index, different fund, so fees and timing differ.

VWCE.DE.name: FTSE All-World
VWCE.DE.note: PROXY benchmark. Vanguard Total World (FTSE Global All Cap) standing in for VWCE (FTSE All-World). Distributing, so it needs dividend adjustment; VWCE accumulates and would not.

^GSPC.name: S&P 500
^GSPC.note: PROXY benchmark. SPY stands in for the S&P 500 index. Distributing.
